messages:
incident-bot: [P1] Suspicious auth fanout detected from multiple IPs -> rapid unauth'ed token attempts against /v1/inference endpoint. Rate spike + increased 401/403s. Initial detection: 6500 reqs/min, 98% failed auth. Affected region: us-west-2. Tags: security, auth, pager.

alice_oncall: seeing the same in dashboards. paging on-call. @bob_sre you free?

bob_sre: on it, pulling rate logs. quick check: top src IPs look spoofed IPv4 ranges, lots of lambda-like user agents.

alice_oncall: immediate mitigation — apply WAF block for the top 20 offending IP ranges and enable stricter auth challenge for /v1/inference. Not rolling back normal traffic.

bob_sre: pushed temporary WAF rule set:
```json
{"action":"block","conditions":[{"ip_in_range":["203.0.113.0/24","198.51.100.0/24"]}],"scope":"/v1/inference","expires_in":"1h"}
```
rule id: waf-temp-3576. Monitor for false positives.

carla_sec: starting triage. Are we sure these are credential stuffing attempts vs internal misconfig? Querying auth logs for token IDs and user agents now.

alice_oncall: we saw service tokens being replayed to many endpoints earlier; risk of leaked creds. @dinesh_eng can you list active service accounts with recent token issuance for the last 72h?

dinesh_eng: running rotation plan. Fast list returned: inference-proxy-svc, batch-worker-svc, telemetry-reader-svc. Prioritizing inference-proxy-svc. My plan: revoke current key, issue new key, push to dedicated secret manager path, then short rolling restart for dependent pods. ETA: 18m for rotate + push.

carla_sec: confirm scope: rotate inference-proxy-svc now. Also create short-lived fallback tokens for canary only. We should also rotate any IAM keys that were created in the suspicious time window (past 24h).

bob_sre: put a temporary rate-limiter gate on auth service for high-volume callers: 10 reqs/min per token, 200 reqs/min per IP / aggregated. Applying with feature-flag so we can unwind quickly.

alice_oncall: good. Start customer impact assessment. @emily_cs can you check which customers had in-flight requests and whether any SLOs/latencies or errors would surface to them? Need rough count + any higher-tier customers impacted.

emily_cs: checking. Early read: ~12 customers had elevated error rates; 3 enterprise customers on Dedicated saw increased 5xx from proxy because of token revocation fallback. Reaching out to their CSMs now. Draft comms: short note + what we fixed, no data exfil confirmed yet.

carla_sec: on data exposure: searching logs for any 2xx responses with sensitive payloads during the window. So far none. Most attempts returned 401/403. We'll keep the data-exfil checklist running.

frank_legal: loop me in for any PII or regulated-customer footprint. If tokens tied to restricted accounts, we may need notification under policy. Keep a timeline.

alice_oncall: timeline note: detection t=3576543210. WAF block and rate-limits applied t=3576543300. Key revoke started t=3576543360. Please annotate actions in the incident doc.

dinesh_eng: rotated inference-proxy-svc key, updated secrets at sm://prod/inference-proxy/keys/v2, deployed rolling restarts to edge pods. Command run:
```bash
smctl put prod/inference-proxy/keys v2 --file=newkey.pem && kubectl rollout restart deploy/edge-proxy -n prod
```
verification: all edge pods reporting new secret hash and auth call tests passing from canary.

bob_sre: traffic levels back down to baseline after WAF + rate-limits. Auth failures still a bit high for some IPs — continuing monitoring.

carla_sec: finished initial token fingerprinting. Found ~7 tokens that were used in the probe window and created from an automated CI job that recently rotated keys. We're investigating CI secrets rotation history. If confirmed, will require CI secret sweep + rotate.

emily_cs: CSMs contacted: two customers acknowledged transient errors, asked for RCA timeline. No customer data reports so far. Prepared template: "We detected anomalous authentication attempts; we applied protections and rotated affected keys. No evidence of successful data access. Will follow up with full RCA."

frank_legal: hold external comms until we confirm CI leak scope. We'll need to coordinate with compliance before any public statement. Internal notice ok.

alice_oncall: action list updated: 1) Monitor for resurgence (bob) 2) Complete token sweep for CI/automation (carla+dinesh) 3) Customer notifications (emily) 4) Legal/compliance assessment (frank) 5) Postmortem + mitigation steps (alice). ETA for next update: +30m.

incident-bot: acknowledged. Incident state: mitigations applied, investigation ongoing, severity: P1 -> hold. Next ping scheduled in 30m.

alice_oncall: quick note for runbook: add step to auto-blacklist IP ranges that exceed 1000 auth failures in 2m window and to correlate with CI job events. Also file a follow-up to harden CI secret rotation audit.

carla_sec: found CI job id: ci/auto/key-rotator-1327 with public log upload to artifact bucket that may have leaked a token earlier today. Starting artifact sweep and access logs retrieval.

dinesh_eng: recommending immediate KMS policy review and enforce HSM-only for high-priv svc keys. I'll open ticket and schedule post-incident change.

emily_cs: will hold customer emails until legal gives the go, but prepping full timeline + what we did for each impacted customer.

frank_legal: review in progress. If CI artifact exposure confirmed, we need to trigger breach-notification checklist. For now, keep updates internal.

alice_oncall: thanks all. next update in 30m or on any major change. If anyone escalates, call the on-call chain. :telephone_receiver:
